This page uses a cleaned dataset of IPF raw lifting results (2010+), with each lifter tagged as **Sumo** or **Conventional**.  
Metric used: **deadlift_fraction = best3_deadlift_kg / total_kg**.

## Load and clean data

```{python}
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import plotly.express as px

CSV_PATH = "data/2025-12-13_deadlift_styles.csv" 
df = pd.read_csv(CSV_PATH)

# Basic hygiene
df["deadlift_style"] = df["deadlift_style"].fillna("Unknown")
df["weight_class"] = df["weight_class"].astype(str)

# Drop rows that can't be used for fraction-based analysis
df_plot = df.dropna(subset=["deadlift_fraction", "sex", "weight_class", "deadlift_style"]).copy()

# Optional: if you want to exclude unknown style from charts
df_plot = df_plot[df_plot["deadlift_style"].isin(["Sumo", "Conventional"])]

# Sort weight classes numerically, with "+" classes last
def wc_sort_key(wc: str):
    wc = str(wc)
    if wc.endswith("+"):
        return (int(wc[:-1]), 1)
    try:
        return (int(wc), 0)
    except ValueError:
        return (10_000, 0)

weight_order = sorted(df_plot["weight_class"].unique(), key=wc_sort_key)

df_plot.head()

```  
## Mean deadlift fraction by weight class and style

```{python}
agg = (df_plot
       .groupby(["sex", "weight_class", "deadlift_style"], as_index=False)
       .agg(mean_fraction=("deadlift_fraction","mean"),
            n=("deadlift_fraction","size")))

fig = px.bar(
    agg,
    x="weight_class",
    y="mean_fraction",
    color="deadlift_style",
    facet_col="sex",
    barmode="group",
    category_orders={"weight_class": weight_order},
    hover_data=["n"]
)
fig.update_yaxes(title="Mean deadlift fraction")
fig.update_xaxes(title="Weight class")
fig
```
